meta.host_note: WSL2 host — numbers are comparative, not absolute

results.name: json
results.notes: Payload = JSON array of canonical CDRs.

results.name: ndjson
results.notes: Payload = one compact-JSON CDR per line.

results.name: csv
results.notes: Header + 10k rows; parse output values are strings (CSV semantics).

results.name: xml
results.notes: defusedxml parse / lxml pretty-print serialize; parse output values are strings (XML text nodes).

results.name: text
results.notes: Payload = one compact-JSON CDR per line (lines opaque to the serializer); parse yields {_line, _line_num} records, serialize round-trips the _line field.

results.name: pm_xml
results.notes: Input constructed: 3GPP TS 32.432 measData, 10 measInfo x 1,000 measValue x 6 Nokia-style counters, numeric_values=true. Serialize output loses measType p-indices (one measInfo per record).

results.name: bytes
results.notes: Passthrough envelope: parse wraps a whole payload in ONE record (_raw/_size); serialize consumes only records[0]. Benched as 10000 x ~486 B payloads (one CDR file/message each); records/s = payloads/s.

results.name: asn1
results.notes: Decode-only by design (serialize raises SerializerError). Input = concatenated BER CdrRecord TLVs (3GPP CDR-file style), encoded with asn1tools from data/cdr.asn.
